data.title: Which Tower in Qassim was Used for Guarding and Star Observation?
data.content:
Buraidah, November 20, 2026, SPA -- Al-Shinanah Tower, located southwest of Al-Rass Governorate in Qassim Region, was used for guarding and observing stars. Historically known as "marqab Al-Shinanah" (Al-Shinanah watchtower), it was built to monitor and protect the surrounding area.
    Dating back to 1250 AH (1838), the tower stands near the site of several battles fought during the various stages of the founding of the Saudi state, extending through the reign of King Abdulaziz bin Abdulrahman Al Saud.
    The tower is distinguished by its conical shape and mud-brick construction. It has eight levels, with a base diameter of seven meters that narrows to one and a half meters at the top. It currently stands 25 meters tall, down from its original height of 32 meters after seven meters collapsed due to rain and strong winds. The tower underwent its first restoration in 1399 AH (1979).
    -- SPA
